tldr: Saturn in Scorpio: discipline must be learned through trust, power, and transformation.
body: With Saturn in Scorpio, the work is facing fear, control, grief, intimacy, and what cannot be healed by staying on the surface. Depth becomes mastery when secrecy gives way to self-honesty.
gift: Emotional endurance, strategic focus, and the ability to transform pain into mature power.
challenge: Control, mistrust, guardedness, or refusing release because vulnerability feels dangerous.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
